about: Original MS-DOS programs held locally, as ToyVM would have to run them: the DOS payload itself, never the Windows DOSBox.exe a GOG release wraps it in. Payloads stay where they are (gitignored); tools/toyvm-dos-corpus.js reads them in place and writes manifest.json and files/<id>.json. Entry commands come from each release's own DOSBox [autoexec] or batch file, cited per title.

titles.title: Constructor (1997 DOS demo)
titles.entrySource: Original README.TXT GETTING STARTED: type GAME at the C:\CN prompt. The README identifies a 20-minute timed demo and documents Enter through splash screens, then mouse-driven PLAY GAME / SELECT / ACCEPT.

toyvmEvidence.summary: Original FALL.EXE entered protected mode, then repeated CS4b:142a (cached base0x28; ASCII error-text decoder bytes) until the30s guard. Exact descriptor/control-flow cause unresolved, not proven DPMI absence.

observedBlocker.text: Native attempt2 entered protected mode but repeatedly failed decode at CS4b:142a/base0x28 until the30s guard; selector/control-flow cause requires diagnosis. This does not prove DPMI/VCPI caused the failure.

toyvmEvidence.summary: Original ACD.EXE printed MSCDEX Driver not installed, executed unhandled INT2F AH15 and exited6 at110:21b.

observedBlocker.text: Actual native attempt2 prints MSCDEX Driver not installed and exits6; INT2F AH15 is unhandled. Implement the queried CD service and real original-media mapping, not fake driver-presence success.

titles.title: Ultima IV: Quest of the Avatar

toyvmEvidence.summary: CLI probe (run-dos.js, origin/main 9df4dc30): ULTIMA.COM started the title program, EGA 320x200, rendered the correct title screen; still running and polling the keyboard when the 200M-dispatch budget ended. No keys sent. One unhandled DOS call: INT 21h AH=2Ah (get date).

Browser /toyvm/ session (headless Chrome, paced 10 MIPS, sound off): the title screen drew, and after Enter the game showed its own main menu (Options: Return to the view / Journey Onward / Initiate New Game), personally viewed -- keyboard input reaches the guest. Character creation and gameplay not attempted.

Ordinary Initiate New Game, Codex name and Male accepted; Space advanced illustrated portal story. Original170s work guard ended before completed creation/world; no game fault or gameplay qualification. Journey Onward packaged save was not used.
